pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Upstream Linux 7.3-rc5 with the hyukudan/strix-halo-usb4-driver stable patch series applied (pinned revision): USB4 STREAM character devices (/dev/tbstreamN), configfs stream services and the GPU-direct DMA-BUF transport for 2-node Strix Halo (BOSGAME M5) inference pools.
Installs alongside the distribution kernels (never overwriting; stock entries remain as rollbacks). The driver's usb4stream-lab host tooling is installed by the same package: modprobe policy gated on the lab release prefix (stock kernels keep thunderbolt_net), the lab service pinned to the installed release via a reviewed-kernel dropin, and the udev refresh rule that keeps /run/usb4stream-layout.json current on cable events.
The ebuild never changes the default boot entry; boot cutover is the caller's responsibility.
